info.title: 3dtiled tile-server
info.description:
A "TiTiler for 3D": live `<format>` → OGC 3D Tiles middleware. CORS-open, no auth, reads public sources only. Every endpoint streams/transcodes on demand — nothing is pre-baked unless you ask for `cache=full` (`/convert`).

See the [playground](/playground) to try requests interactively, or the [project docs]({{DOCS_URL}}) for the full architecture writeup.

tags.name: tiles
tags.description: /tiles, /stream, /convert — the materialization continuum: live range-streaming through to a fully preprocessed+cached tileset, over one query-param axis (?cache=).

tags.name: transforms
tags.description: /3dtiles-self-contained, /3dtiles-tools, /gltf — package extraction and per-tile 3D Tiles/glTF transforms.

tags.name: extract
tags.description: /extract/{kind} — bounding-box + geometric-error crop/export of a loaded tileset.

tags.name: bing
tags.description: /bing — Bing Maps 3D (td1 implicit manifest) → OGC 3D Tiles.

get.summary: GET /tiles/tileset.json — unified entry, dispatches to /stream or /convert based on ?cache=
get.description: One HTTP surface over the whole materialization continuum. `cache=none|hierarchy` dispatches in-process to `/stream` (true range-streaming, per-format adapters); `cache=full` dispatches to `/convert` (preprocess the whole dataset once, then serve static). No redirect — the query string carries straight through.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Absolute URL of the source dataset (e.g. a `.copc.laz`, Potree `cloud.js`, SOG manifest, etc.).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Source format. Auto-detected from the URL/extension when omitted for most formats.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: none = fully live, nothing cached. hierarchy = tree cached in RAM, tiles per-request. full = whole dataset converted to disk once, then served static.

parameters.name: prefetch
parameters.description: Octree formats (COPC/Potree) only — number of extra LOD levels to eagerly resolve bounds for on tileset.json build.

parameters.name: tiling
parameters.description: Octree formats only — 3D Tiles 1.1 implicit tiling vs. a fully-materialized explicit tree.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Globe placement: longitude (deg). With lat, attaches a LOCAL (non-georeferenced) dataset to a real location as a root ENU transform, so any 3D Tiles client (Cesium for Unreal/Unity, QGIS, CesiumJS) streams it in place. Ignored if the source carries its own georeference.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Globe placement: latitude (deg). See lon.

parameters.name: alt
parameters.description: Globe placement: ellipsoidal altitude in meters (with lon/lat).

parameters.name: heading
parameters.description: Globe placement: compass heading in degrees, clockwise from north, rotating the dataset about local up (with lon/lat).

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Globe placement: uniform scale factor (with lon/lat).

400.description: Bad request (unknown cache level, missing url, etc.)

get.summary: GET /stream/tileset.json — true online range-streaming (copc/potree/sog/lcc/rad/i3s/threemx/geosplats)
get.description: Range-reads the source's own persisted hierarchy (no full decode/convert) to build a tileset.json; individual tiles are converted on demand as the client requests them via `/stream/tile/...` or `/stream/subtrees/...` URIs embedded in the response.

parameters.name: tiling
parameters.description: COPC/Potree only.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Globe placement: longitude (deg). With lat, attaches a LOCAL (non-georeferenced) dataset to a real location as a root ENU transform, so any 3D Tiles client (Cesium for Unreal/Unity, QGIS, CesiumJS) streams it in place. Ignored if the source carries its own georeference.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Globe placement: latitude (deg). See lon.

parameters.name: alt
parameters.description: Globe placement: ellipsoidal altitude in meters (with lon/lat).

parameters.name: heading
parameters.description: Globe placement: compass heading in degrees, clockwise from north, rotating the dataset about local up (with lon/lat).

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Globe placement: uniform scale factor (with lon/lat).

get.summary: GET /convert/tileset.json — preprocess + cache the whole dataset once (cache=full), any supported format
get.description: Converts the entire source dataset to 3D Tiles on first request and caches the result on disk; subsequent requests are served statically. Works for every format the meta-converter supports, including ones with no streaming adapter.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Auto-detected from the URL when omitted.

parameters.name: centroids
parameters.description: Splat formats only — centroids-only (points, no covariance) preview instead of full Gaussian splats.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Globe placement: longitude (deg). With lat, attaches a LOCAL (non-georeferenced) dataset to a real location as a root ENU transform, so any 3D Tiles client (Cesium for Unreal/Unity, QGIS, CesiumJS) streams it in place. Ignored if the source carries its own georeference.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Globe placement: latitude (deg). See lon.

parameters.name: alt
parameters.description: Globe placement: ellipsoidal altitude in meters (with lon/lat).

parameters.name: heading
parameters.description: Globe placement: compass heading in degrees, clockwise from north, rotating the dataset about local up (with lon/lat).

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Globe placement: uniform scale factor (with lon/lat).

200.description: A 3D Tiles tileset.json (subsequent requests served from disk cache)

get.summary: GET /3dtiles-self-contained/{key} — serve a .3tz / .3dtiles self-contained package
get.description: `{key}` is a path within the archive (`tileset.json` for the root, or any tile path the root references) — the FIRST path segment is treated as the archive locator.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Path or URL to the .3tz/.3dtiles archive.

200.description: tileset.json or a tile file extracted from the archive

get.summary: GET /3dtiles-tools/tileset.json — 3D Tiles 1.0 → 1.1 transforms
get.description: `tool=implicit-to-explicit` reads binary `.subtree` files (OCTREE/QUADTREE) and builds an explicit children tree. `tool=upgrade` reads an existing explicit 1.0 tileset, bumps its version to 1.1, and rewrites content URIs so each b3dm/pnts tile (including nested tileset.json references) is converted to glTF 2.0 on demand — fixing legacy glTF 1.0 b3dm content that most modern renderers can no longer parse natively.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Remote tileset.json URL (mutually exclusive with dir).

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: Local filesystem path to the tileset directory (mutually exclusive with url).

parameters.name: tilesetFile
parameters.description: upgrade tool only — filename within dir/url to read.

200.description: A 3D Tiles 1.1 tileset.json with rewritten content URIs

get.summary: GET /gltf/tileset.json — per-tile glTF-Transform pipeline over an existing tileset
get.description: Proxies an existing tileset.json, rewriting content URIs through /gltf/tile.glb so each glTF/GLB tile is decoded (Draco, meshopt, KTX2 → PNG/JPEG) on the fly — useful for renderers that can't decode one of those encodings natively.

parameters.name: ops
parameters.description: Comma-separated combination of ops (`style: form, explode: false` — e.g. `ops=draco,ktx`). `decompress` is shorthand for `draco,meshopt,ktx` together.

parameters.name: tex
parameters.description: Output format for decoded KTX2 textures.

200.description: A tileset.json with rewritten content URIs

get.summary: GET /gltf/tile.glb — decode a single glTF/GLB tile (same ops as /gltf/tileset.json)
get.description: The per-tile endpoint /gltf/tileset.json's rewritten content URIs point at — callable directly against any glTF/GLB URL, not just ones reached via a rewritten tileset.

parameters.name: ops
parameters.description: Comma-separated combination of ops (`style: form, explode: false` — e.g. `ops=draco,ktx`). `decompress` is shorthand for `draco,meshopt,ktx` together.

parameters.name: tex
parameters.description: Output format for decoded KTX2 textures.

get.summary: GET /bing/tileset.json — Bing Maps 3D → OGC 3D Tiles
get.description: Wraps Bing Maps' own td1 implicit-tiling manifest (tf=3dv4 GLB tiles) as a standard OGC 3D Tiles tileset.json.

parameters.name: g
parameters.description: Bing generation/session id. Defaults to a known-good value if omitted.

parameters.name: decompress
parameters.description: Route tiles through the /gltf decode pipeline (Bing content is often Draco/KTX2-encoded).

parameters.name: globe
parameters.description: Low-zoom globe shell: deepest face-local level that gets a basemap-draped ellipsoid patch (default 11), or "off" to disable. Bing mesh only starts at level 12, so without this every zoomed-out view is empty space.

parameters.name: basemap
parameters.description: Raster URL template with {z}/{x}/{y} for the globe shell. Defaults to OpenStreetMap (token-free); attribution is emitted in the tileset asset.copyright.

get.summary: GET /extract/{kind} — bounding-box + geometric-error crop/export of a loaded tileset
get.description: Traverses a tileset.json (any format this server can serve), keeping only tiles that intersect the given lon/lat/height bounding box down to a target geometric error, and re-exports the result as the requested output kind.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The tileset.json to crop (any endpoint on this server, or a third-party 3D Tiles source).

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: west,south,minHeight,east,north,maxHeight — degrees,degrees,meters.

parameters.name: maxGE
parameters.description: Maximum geometric error to descend to. 0 = finest available.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Optional 16-number column-major modelMatrix override (matches an on-screen Z-offset/local-frame nudge applied in the viewer).

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: las kind only — disk-free two-pass streaming instead of buffering in memory.

200.description: The requested output file (LAS/LAZ, GLB, COPC, tileset.json, ZIP, or a splat format)

get.summary: GET /proxy — generic CORS-open passthrough for public sources
get.description: Fetches an arbitrary public URL server-side and re-serves the bytes with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` — for sources that don't send CORS headers themselves (the common failure mode for hotlinked XYZ basemap tiles fetched via WebGL texture upload, unlike an `` tag which tolerates missing CORS headers).

200.description: The proxied response body, byte-for-byte, with CORS headers added

get.summary: GET /progress — poll progress of a server-side cache=hierarchy/full operation
Meta-tileset over N child tilesets (MosaicJSON/STAC-style)
get.description: Serves ONE 3D Tiles tileset whose children external-reference each given tileset URL, with per-child bounding spheres derived from each child root (fetched once, cached). Children can be any 3D-Tiles URL, including this server's own /stream, /convert, /bing or /3dtiles-self-contained endpoints - so one endpoint can mosaic COPC + Potree + LCC + RAD + remote 3D Tiles together. A local child can be globe-placed first via /stream's lon/lat placement params. Unreachable children are skipped and listed in asset.extras.failed.

parameters.name: set
parameters.description: Expand a curated demo set of real, public, key-less tilesets: "opendata" = the ten open datasets from 3D Tiles' own RESOURCES.md (four continents, all three boundingVolume kinds); "iconem-open" = a local Iconem set: the Angkor campaign as 23 individual tilesets, plus Geghard; "world" = both (33). Composes with ?url=. GET /aggregate/demo.json lists their contents.

parameters.name: urls
parameters.description: Comma-separated child tileset.json URLs (each URL-encoded).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Repeated form: one child tileset.json URL per url= param.

parameters.name: nest
parameters.description: Spatial auto-nesting, so a renderer culls whole regions instead of considering every dataset. "auto" (default) builds a web-mercator quadtree once there are 8 or more children; "mercator" (aliases 1/true/webmerc/quadtree) forces it; "geodetic" (aliases morton/implicit/cesium) instead subdivides in longitude/latitude the way 3D Tiles implicit tiling does for a region bounding volume (Cesium's GeographicTilingScheme: 2x1 cells at level 0); "flat" (aliases 0/false/none) forces a flat root. Note Morton (Z-order) is an ADDRESSING scheme, not a projection - both trees use it, they differ in what space they subdivide. Each dataset is placed at the deepest level whose cell still comfortably contains it (from its root bounding sphere), the trie is path-compressed, and each group node gets 2x its children's geometric error so distant groups are never traversed. Groups and datasets carry extras.cell with the scheme, path key, level and Morton index.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Cache lifetime in SECONDS for both the assembled mosaic and each child's fetched root. Defaults to 86400 (one day): assembling N children costs N round-trips, so it must not happen per request, but a mosaic that never re-reads its children cannot notice one moved. ttl=0 bypasses the cache in both directions - use it while a dataset is being re-tiled. Child fetches run through a 16-way pool; unbounded concurrency loses children at scale.

parameters.name: only
parameters.description: Keep only children whose URL contains this case-insensitive substring. Repeatable. Applied BEFORE exclude. Motivating case: a site re-scanned yearly yields N tilesets over the same ground and you usually want one - e.g. only=_d2024. Filtering is server-side, so the result is still a plain 3D Tiles endpoint you can paste anywhere; the URL is the whole state. An empty result is a 400, not an empty tileset.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Drop children whose URL contains this case-insensitive substring. Repeatable. Applied after only.

parameters.name: native
parameters.description: Also describe each Potree leaf in its source format: content.extensions.ICONEM_content_source = { format, version, encoding, uri, transform }, listed in extensionsUsed (never required). content.uri stays the /stream 3D Tiles wrapper, so clients that do not know the extension are unaffected. transform maps the source's own coordinates to the leaf frame. Used by the viewer's 3DTRjs 'Native Potree leaves' setting.

200.description: Meta tileset.json (root ADD-refine, children = external tilesets)

get.summary: Snap offsets of a mosaic, as they resolve
get.description: Takes the same query as /aggregate/tileset.json, and needs &snap=<terrain>. Answers newline-delimited JSON: a first line { total }, then one line per dataset as its offset resolves: { id, height, snap: { terrain, dz, bins, spread } }, dz null when it could not be measured. The offsets land in the cache the mosaic reads, so a client can show the unsnapped mosaic at once and request the snapped one when this ends.

parameters.name: snap
parameters.description: The terrain, as on /aggregate/tileset.json.

422.description: None of the datasets could be placed.

get.summary: Hierarchy statistics of any tileset (depth/breadth walk)
get.description: Walks a tileset tile tree - explicit children, 3D Tiles 1.1 implicit tiling (fetching + decoding .subtree availability), and external-tileset refs - returning per-level aggregates (tiles, content tiles, GE range) plus a bounded node dump for graph rendering. Works against this server's own /stream//convert//aggregate output or any remote tileset URL.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: tileset.json URL to walk.

parameters.name: maxNodes
parameters.description: Node budget - the walk truncates (truncated:true) past it.

parameters.name: maxDepth
parameters.description: Depth cap.

parameters.name: sample
parameters.description: Download N content tiles (stratified across depth, leaves and intermediate nodes) and report approximate triangle/point/vertex counts, glTF extensions used, texture MIME types and compression (draco/meshopt/ktx2/spz/lgsc). Only the GLB JSON chunk is parsed - no geometry decode. Off by default: the rest of the walk reads only tileset JSON and subtree buffers.

parameters.name: maxExternal
parameters.description: Cap on external-tileset refs followed during the walk (max 1024). Formats that express LoD as chains of external tilesets - RAD is the extreme case - and /aggregate mosaics, which are made of them, exhaust this long before the node budget. When they do, the response reports truncatedBy: ["external"].

200.description: Per-level aggregates, totals (leafNodes, maxFanout, maxDepth), a bounded node dump, and truncatedBy[] naming which budget stopped the walk ("nodes" | "depth" | "external") alongside the limits actually applied.

get.summary: Depth/breadth visualization page (radial tree + per-level chart)
get.description: Self-contained HTML page rendering /stats as a cosmograph-style radial depth/breadth graph, per-level breadth chart, KPI tiles and table. ?url= preloads a tileset; ?theme=dark|light overrides the OS color scheme.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: tileset.json URL to preload.

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: Force color scheme.

get.summary: GET /bing/globe/<face>-<level>-<x>-<y>.glb — low-zoom globe shell tile
get.description: A basemap-draped ellipsoid patch covering one Bing tile region, synthesized because Bing has no mesh above face-local level 12. Absolute-ECEF positions, no tile transform (a transform would be inherited by the Bing subtree beneath). Referenced automatically by /bing/fragment; rarely fetched directly.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: <face>-<level>-<x>-<y>, same addressing as /bing/tile

parameters.name: g
parameters.description: Bing generation/session id.

parameters.name: basemap
parameters.description: Raster URL template with {z}/{x}/{y} for the globe shell. Defaults to OpenStreetMap (token-free); attribution is emitted in the tileset asset.copyright.

get.summary: List the curated demo sets available to /aggregate?set=
get.description: Machine-readable index of the demo mosaics, so a UI can offer them without hardcoding 33 URLs. Each entry gives a label, a child count, and the child list.

200.description: Map of set name to { label, count, entries }

post.summary: Upload a set manifest, then mosaic it with /aggregate?set=upload-<hash>
post.description: Body: a local-set manifest ({ label?, entries: [{ url, format: potree|copc|3dtiles, name?, project?, scene?, date?, crs?, lon?, lat? }] }) or the bare entries array, up to 10 MB. Held in memory for 24 h after last use (a restart clears it), never listed in demo.json. The name is a hash of the entries, so re-sending the same manifest returns the same set name. Every /aggregate/tileset.json and index.json parameter works with it.

400.description: Not JSON, no entries, an entry without an absolute http(s) url, or an unknown format

get.summary: GET /export — is export enabled, and the recent jobs
get.description: Off unless the server was started with `TILED_ALLOW_EXPORT=1` (the desktop app sets it), and loopback clients only: it writes to this machine's disk.

403.description: Export disabled, or not a loopback client

post.summary: POST /export — materialise a tileset into a local folder
post.description:
Crawls any 3D Tiles URL — this server's /stream, /convert, /tiles, /aggregate or /proxy outputs, or a remote tileset — and writes a self-contained static copy: every tileset JSON and content file, uris made relative, implicit tilings expanded to explicit (see `packages/tile-server/export-live.js`). Returns a job id to poll. The folder must be empty.

Off unless the server was started with `TILED_ALLOW_EXPORT=1` (the desktop app sets it), and loopback clients only: it writes to this machine's disk.

url.description: Tileset URL; a server-relative path ("/stream/tileset.json?…") means this server

outDir.description: Absolute path of an empty (or new) folder

maxDepth.description: Keep tiles down to this depth (counted across external tilesets); null = everything

method.description: crawl = download `url` as served (any source); convert = run the per-format offline converter on `src`

keepImplicit.description: crawl: copy .subtree files and templated tiles instead of expanding implicit tilings

pack.description: also pack the folder into these single-file formats

verify.description: Check the folder at the end. counts: walks it as a client would, reads every tile's header, and compares the points with the total a Potree or COPC source declares. sample: also reads a few tiles of each level in full. full: reads every tile in full. The result is `verify` in the report.

hierarchyErrors.description: A part of the hierarchy still unread after retries (a subtree, an external tileset, a Potree .hrc). error: stop the export. warn: list it under `hierarchyFailures` and export the rest without that branch.

src.description: convert: local path or URL of the raw source

options.description: convert: {tiling: implicit|explicit, scale, geScale, geLayer, centroidsOnly}

schema.description: crawl needs {url, outDir}; convert needs {method: "convert", src, outDir}

403.description: Export disabled, or not a loopback client

get.summary: GET /export/{id} — progress or result of an export
get.description: `state` is running | done | failed | cancelled. `progress` counts tilesets, files discovered/written, bytes and failures; `preview` (when done) serves the exported copy back.

delete.description: The folder keeps whatever was written so far.

get.summary: GET /export/{id}/files/{path} — a file of an exported folder
get.description: Serves the exported copy as a static host would, to preview it. Only folders this server exported are served; paths outside them are refused.
